usageGuide.title: Usage Guide
usageGuide.content:
Edit this file to add your usage instructions.

File path: frontend/src/components/UsageGuide.tsx

Basic usage:
1. Connect a device from the Devices page
2. Create and manage keyboard mappings in Mappings
3. Adjust display parameters via ADB Resolution
4. Configure streaming in Scrcpy Presets

latencyCompare.title: Performance & Latency
latencyCompare.desc: Capture the current phone screen (saved to the phone's internal storage) and capture the PC streaming window (saved locally), then compare them to gauge relative latency. You can also upload phone screenshots here to inspect.
latencyCompare.noImage: No screenshot yet. Click a button above to capture.
latencyCompare.previewNotice: This is a preview reference, not the instantaneous latency in the real environment.
latencyCompare.measureTip: Screenshots below are for reference only
latencyCompare.measureTipDetail: To accurately measure real streaming latency, use another phone to record the streaming window and the phone screen side by side. The game clock difference between the two screenshots is a rough reference, but their timestamp difference mainly reflects screenshot command latency, not the real streaming latency.
latencyCompare.perfMonitorGuideTitle: Want more detailed latency data? Use perf_monitor
latencyCompare.perfMonitorGuideDetail:
The screenshot comparison above only gives a rough sense of overall latency. For detailed metrics, use the two monitor pages under perf_monitor (zero third-party deps, stdlib only):
· Screen performance: the main program writes per-stage probe timings (network read, video decode, UI render, audio decode, etc.) to perf.jsonl every second. Run python monitor.py to view (default port 8765; shows avg / p95 / max curves, FPS and dropped-frame stats).
· Mapping performance: every touch event injected into the phone is written to data/touch_probe.jsonl. Run python touch_monitor.py to view (default port 8766; shows event rate, event intervals and the event stream).
Options: --dir to set the jsonl directory, --port to change the port, --host to change the listen address, --no-browser to skip opening the browser.
latencyCompare.screenPerfDesc: Records per-stage streaming timings (network read, video decode, UI render, audio decode) plus FPS / dropped-frame stats, one row per second. View curves with perf_monitor/monitor.py.
latencyCompare.touchProbeDesc: Appends every touch event injected into the phone (timestamp, interval since the last event, action, pointer, coords) to data/touch_probe.jsonl. Use it to check whether phone-side stutter is caused by event density / jitter. View with perf_monitor/touch_monitor.py. Enabled by default.
latencyCompare.moveThresholdDesc: For consecutive Move events on the same pointer_id, if dx² + dy² < threshold² the event is dropped. This significantly reduces event count, CPU scheduling, network messages, log volume and UI pressure, with very little impact on the actual feel. Start with 2~6 px; the payoff is biggest in high-frequency micro-move scenarios (FPS view / direction pad). Larger thresholds denoise harder, but going too large can produce visible "jumps" while aiming in games.

bind.autoInputPlaceholder: Double click to enable button recording
bind.hint: Multiple mappings can share the same shortcut and trigger together. Extra keys won't block a combo, but a longer matching combo takes priority.

pointerId.label: PointerID
pointerId.hint: Each PointerID represents a single virtual finger, which can only touch one coordinate at a time. Buttons sharing the same PointerID will conflict if pressed simultaneously — assign different PointerIDs to any buttons that may be pressed together.

id.label: Config ID
id.hint: Used by scripts or external APIs to reference this mapping exactly. Click the copy icon to copy it.

common.refreshBackground: View phone screen or virtual display
common.noMainDevice: Main controlled device not found, please control the device on the devices page
common.randomOffsetXHint: Random horizontal offset applied each activation, picked from [-offset, +offset]. Set to 0 to disable.
common.randomOffsetYHint: Random vertical offset applied each activation, picked from [-offset, +offset]. Set to 0 to disable.

scriptHooks.beforeHint: Runs before this mapping action. Leave empty to skip. Scripts block the current mapping flow, so slow scripts can cause input latency or stuck mappings.
scriptHooks.beforePlaceholder: Script to run before the action
scriptHooks.afterHint: Runs after this mapping action. Leave empty to skip. Scripts block the current mapping flow, so slow scripts can cause input latency or stuck mappings.
scriptHooks.afterPlaceholder: Script to run after the action

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - SingleTap
setting.syncHint: When enabled, the touch lasts as long as the shortcut is held, ignoring the duration setting.
setting.durationHint: Touch duration before auto-release (ms). An ongoing tap won't be interrupted by pressing the shortcut again.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - LongPress
setting.durationHint: How long the finger stays pressed before auto-release (ms). Useful for games that need a long-press to trigger.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - RepeatTap
setting.durationHint: How long each touch lasts (ms). Should be shorter than the repeat interval.
setting.intervalHint: Time between the start of consecutive touches (ms). The duration should be shorter than this interval.
setting.randomOffsetXHint: Random offset is recalculated for each repeat tap, so every tap lands at a slightly different X coordinate.
setting.randomOffsetYHint: Random offset is recalculated for each repeat tap, so every tap lands at a slightly different Y coordinate.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - MultipleTap
setting.durationHint: How long this touch is held before release (ms).
setting.waitHint: Wait time before this touch operation begins (ms).
setting.operationsHint: Sequence of touch operations executed in order: wait → touch → hold for duration → release. Edit positions in the visual editor.
setting.operationsHelp: Drag with the left mouse button and add or edit with the right mouse button

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - Swipe
setting.durationHint: Total time to complete the entire swipe motion (ms).
setting.startHint: Starting coordinates of the swipe (you can also drag the button on canvas to move the start point).
setting.bezierWaveHint: When on, the swipe follows a gentle one-sided curved path (quadratic Bezier) from start to end instead of a straight line.
setting.enableRandomizationHint: Replaces straight line segments with smooth curves that have random arc curvature, making each swipe trajectory slightly different.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - DirectionPad
setting.initDurationHint: Initial slide duration before the pad responds (ms). Helps work around games that miss the initial touch.
setting.maxOffsetHint: Maximum drag distance of the virtual finger from the pad center along the horizontal and vertical axes.
setting.upBoostKeyHint: While this modifier key is held, pressing the up key can extend beyond the normal maximum offset range.
setting.upBoostScaleHint: Multiplier applied to the upward offset while the boost key is held. E.g., 2.0 doubles the upward reach.
setting.enableRandomizationHint: Adds random anchor offset, arc-shaped slide paths, and continuous drift to simulate natural finger movement.
setting.randomOffsetHint: Random offset range applied to the pad center each time it is pressed.
setting.randomDistanceScaleHint: Random multiplier applied to the distance from the center to the target point on each direction change.
setting.jitterOffsetHint: Range for touch drift around the current target point while holding the same direction.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - MouseCastSpell
setting.centerHint: Reference point for cast direction calculation, typically the character's position on screen. Adjust if the character is not centered due to perspective projection.
setting.scaleFactorHint: Controls horizontal/vertical scaling of the cast direction mapping. Use to calibrate mouse-to-game direction when the game has perspective distortion (e.g. Honor of Kings: X=7, Y=10).
setting.castRadiusHint: Mouse distance beyond this range drags the skill button to max radius; below it, distance scales proportionally.
setting.dragRadiusHint: The maximum drag radius of the skill button in the game UI.

releaseMode.label: Release timing
releaseMode.hint: OnRelease: activates on press, releases on release. OnPress: releases immediately on press. OnSecondPress: first press activates, second press releases.

setting.castNoDirectionHint: Ignores direction settings and simply taps at the cast position. Similar to SingleTap but cancelable.
setting.enableInitialSwipeRandomizationHint: When enabled, the initial drag uses a randomized arc path; when disabled, it uses a straight path.
setting.editHelp: Drag with the left mouse button and edit with the right mouse button

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - PadCastSpell
setting.dragRadiusHint: The maximum drag radius of the skill button in the game UI.
setting.blockHint: Blocks direction pad shortcuts while casting to prevent input conflicts.
setting.enableRandomizationHint: Adds random anchor offset, arc-shaped slide paths, and continuous micro-jitter to simulate natural finger movement.

releaseMode.label: Release timing
releaseMode.hint: OnRelease: activates on press, releases on release. OnSecondPress: first press activates, second press releases.

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - Wheel
setting.deadRadiusHint: While the cursor stays inside the deadzone the touch is locked to the wheel center; drag out to start selecting a sector.
setting.startAngleHint: Starting direction (degrees) of sector 0, to align with the game wheel orientation.
setting.hoverDelayHint: Milliseconds to hover on the target sector before auto-committing (hover-delay mode only).
setting.jitterIntervalHint: How often (ms) a random offset is applied to the wheel target while active. Larger values mean lower frequency and better responsiveness; 50~200ms recommended.
setting.jitterOffsetHint: Maximum random offset per drift tick (px, based on 1080 height). Set to 0 to disable drift entirely.

setting.sensitivityHint: Only active in FPS mode. Fire button drag speed relative to mouse movement, independent from FPS sensitivity.
setting.preserveFpsControlHint: When enabled, the fire touch stays fixed and FPS view control keeps responding to mouse movement.
setting.title: Mapping Configuration - Fire

setting.sensitivityHint: View rotation speed relative to mouse movement. At screen edges, the finger auto-recenters to continue tracking.
setting.maxOffsetHint: Maximum distance from the FPS start position to the local boundary. Set an axis to 0 for no local limit.
setting.touchModeHint: When the touch reaches the local boundary, it returns to the start position and continues dragging. Single touch reuses the same pointer; dual touch hands off to an alternate pointer.
setting.anotherPointerIdHint: The other pointer_id alternated with the primary pointer. It must differ from the primary pointer.
setting.dualTouchStrategyHint: Delay presses the alternate pointer before lifting the old pointer after a wait. Overlap lets both pointers participate briefly on the next move.
setting.singleTouchIntervalHint: Milliseconds to wait after lifting the current pointer before pressing the same pointer at the start. Set to 0 for immediate press.
setting.dualTouchIntervalHint: Milliseconds to wait after pressing the alternate pointer before lifting the old pointer. Set to 0 for immediate lift.
setting.title: Mapping Configuration - FPS

setting.sensitivityHint: View drag speed relative to mouse movement. Higher = faster.
setting.title: Mapping Configuration - Observation
setting.maxRadiusHint: Max drag distance from the start position. Set to 0 for no limit.

home.emptyBind: There are buttons without a bind configuration!
home.quickSwitchHint: Focus the field and press a key chord. Ctrl/Alt + F1-F12 is recommended to avoid game bindings. Backspace or Delete clears it.
home.quickSwitchNeedShortcut: Set a keyboard shortcut before enabling quick switch
home.migration: Migration to current main device size
home.fileInputPlaceholder: Please enter the new config name
home.deletePrompt: Are you sure you want to delete this?
home.clearAllPrompt: Are you sure you want to clear all presets? (The active preset will not be deleted)
home.differentName: The new config name cannot be the same as the current config!
home.maskOverlayDesc: Overlay an image (map/floating) on the mask window. Put the image under assets/overlay/ and enter a relative path (e.g. overlay/map.png).
home.boundSettingsHint: The keys below are occupied by preset switching or macro presets. The mapping keys below cannot use these keys.
home.latencyTip: This image is the current phone frame. Compare it with the actual window to gauge latency.

override.createButton: Create sub-preset: only override a few button positions on top of a main preset
override.editButton: Edit sub-preset: tweak the overridden button positions
override.duplicateTitle: Duplicate sub-preset (usually not needed; create a new one instead)
override.hint: A sub-preset references a main preset and only overrides the button positions you change. All other buttons are inherited from the main preset. Useful for scenarios like aim / drive / scope where only a few buttons move, so quick switch stays cheap and avoids clashes with bind keys.
override.noChanges: Adjust at least one button before saving
override.changedCount: {{count}} button(s) changed (only these will be written into the sub-preset)
override.editReadonlyHint: Tip: when editing an existing sub-preset the name is locked. To rename, delete and re-create.
override.quickSwitchBindFailed: Saved, but binding the quick switch failed: {{error}}

setting.title: Mapping Configuration - Script
setting.pressed_script_placeholder: Executed once when the hotkey is pressed
setting.pressedScriptHint: Runs once on press. Supports the full scripting DSL.
setting.intervalHint: Interval between script repeats while holding (ms). Script execution time should be less than this interval.
setting.held_script_placeholder: Repeatedly executed while the hotkey is held down
setting.heldScriptHint: Runs repeatedly at the specified interval while held. Execution time should be less than the interval.
setting.released_script_placeholder: Executed once when the hotkey is released
setting.releasedScriptHint: Runs once on release. Supports the full scripting DSL.

setting.title: Mapping - Direction Pad (Toggle Sprint)
setting.enabledHint: Enabled by default, but only works when Up Boost has a key. Press the boost key once to latch sprint and release it normally; A/D keep sprint active, while S/back cancels immediately. To cancel with the boost key, press it again and release it. Starting sprint also cancels stealth.

setting.title: Mapping - Stealth Toggle
setting.triggerKeyHint: Tap once to press the configured stealth coordinate; tap again to leave stealth. Entering stealth cancels latched sprint.
setting.cancelKeysHint: These keys are OR conditions, not a chord. Pressing any one while stealth is active taps the stealth coordinate again. Defaults to W/A/S/D/Left Shift/Right Shift.

settings.mappingButtonScaleTip: Only adjusts the visual size of the mapping button. The actual adb tap point stays at the button center, so operation accuracy is unaffected.
settings.displayIdTip: Ignored for video connections when virtual display is enabled
settings.newDisplayEnabledTip: Only applies when the video channel is enabled; display ID is still used when video is disabled
settings.audioDupTip: Only available when audio source is PLAYBACK. When enabled, audio also keeps playing on the device.
settings.screenOffTimeoutTip: Automatic screen timeout while controlling the device. In milliseconds, -1 keeps the current setting, 0 prevents automatic screen off, positive values turn the screen off after that delay. The original setting is restored after control stops.
settings.webBindAddrTip: 127.0.0.1 allows local access only; 0.0.0.0 allows LAN access. Use it only on trusted networks.

about.title: About
about.intro: A Scrcpy client built with Rust, Bevy, and React that lets you control your Android device as if you were using an game emulator.

adbPackages.title: ADB Package List
adbPackages.noDevice: No controlled device. Please control a device on the Devices page first.

startupSize.title: Startup Size
startupSize.desc: These parameters control the initial window size and position at startup. They only exist to ensure the program launches smoothly. Once connected, drag the window to auto-adjust — no manual changes needed.
